title: Organisation
description: One organisation round a style: a group of people that acted together (a crew, a collective, a council, a studio, a company), a channel (a magazine, a publisher, a gallery, a salon, a platform), or a body that paid for the work (a court, a church, a house, a foundation, a fund). A style does not own it. The organisation names the styles that it carried and the part it took. Rule 4 of the curation rules: each style has at least one organisation.

kind.description: crew: artists who work as one and sign as one (Die Brücke, Archigram). collective: a loose network, a society or a scene with members (a club, a guild of makers). council: a body that sets rules, grants a mark or judges (CIAM, a guild that licensed painters). studio: a design or art practice that makes work for others. company: a firm that makes and sells (Braun, a fashion house, a restaurant). school: a place that teaches. gallery: a showroom that shows and sells work. dealer: a trader who buys from the makers and sells on. publisher: a publishing house or a press. magazine: a periodical. label: a record label. salon: a juried or open show held again and again. exhibition: one show. venue: a hall or a club where people met to see or hear the work. auction-house: a house that sells at auction. court: a royal or princely household and its manufactories. church: a church body or the works board of a cathedral. house: a family or a dynasty that paid as a unit (Medici, Rothschild). foundation: a private foundation or a prize body. state-programme: a state body or programme that paid for the work. fund: an investment fund or a venture firm. platform: a web site or an app where people post work.

founded.description: The first year. Null when no open source gives it. Do not guess a year.

closed.description: The last year. Null when it is still open, or when no open source gives it.

place.description: The city, or "web" for a platform.

part.description: launched: the style started here. exhibited: it showed the work. published: it printed or posted the work or the argument. taught: it trained the makers. made: it produced the work. sold: it traded the work. gathered: the makers met here. shaped: its members set the look of the style. opposed: it fought the style. revived: it brought the style back after a gap. funded: it paid for the work or the makers (the flows are in data/funding/).

people.description: Person ids from data/people/ who ran or shaped the organisation.

members.description: The people in a group, with the role and the years. Use it for a crew, a collective, a council or a studio.

statement.description: The manifesto or the vow, in our own words, with a link to the full text.

moves.description: Dated events: what the organisation did.

relations.description: Links to other organisation ids in data/orgs/.
